name: Ramakrishnan Ananthanarayanan
headline: Vice President, Professional Services Segment
about:
I am a seasoned Technology consulting executive with 26 years in the industry with global management experience. Over the course of my career, I have lived and worked in the US, Germany, Australia and India servicing clients in all these regions. My specialization is on consultative sales, building trusted senior client relationships and executing and governing large multi-million dollar client engagements.

At LTIMindtree, I have started up and grown new clients in the Technology and Services segment. This includes marquee Big 4 and High Tech Clients who I have sold to and developed into multi million dollar annual businesses for LTIMindtree delivering 100%+ growth every year. 

Prior to LTIMindtree, I worked for Cognizant for 11 years in the Communications, Media and Technology segment in India, US and Germany. I held Client Partner roles with marquee clients in Europe and US in the CMT segment.

In the early stages of my career, I performed technical, project management, presales and solution architect roles for clients in the Telecom sector working for Tata Consultancy Services and Infosys.

I am a well rounded professional who brings in experience with client relationships, sales, operations, P&L management, solution delivery along with domain expertise in the CMT and Services industry segments.

I had the opportunity to co-author a white paper that was published in Telemanagement Forum, International Engineering Consortium (IEC) and Pacific Telecommunications. I was invited to speak at ASUG (America's SAP User Group) on my white paper topic related to Impact of Convergence on Product Framework.

Having a US MBA and a technology degree from one of India's premier engineering schools and having worked across the globe over two decades, my global perspective and understanding of various business cultures is my core strength.
